page_title: SEV 1-1 VIL | Sevilla v Villarreal 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes a long run up and smacks the long-range free kick towards goal, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
90+9' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal). Sevilla win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+8' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
90+8' Pepe Reina (Villarreal) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
90+7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Villarreal players aren’t happy.
90+6' The referee shows a yellow card to Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+5' That was a nice piece of skill by Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to release a superb effort which goes into the middle of the goal.
90+3' It is time for a substitution. Oliver Torres (Sevilla) is on for Fernando.
90+3' Fernando (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+1' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
90+1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic easily deals with the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

89' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Filip Jorgensen pulls off an easy save.
87' Substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) replaces Jose Luis Morales.
85' 15:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
84' Ilias Akhomach comes onto the pitch after Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
84' Marcelino is forced to make a change. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Francis Coquelin.
83' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
81' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
80' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:1.
75' 1 - 0 Goal! Adria Pedrosa gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Kike Salas (Sevilla) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the top left corner. 1:0.
72' Diego Alonso has decided to make a change. Kike Salas (Sevilla) replaces Tanguy Nianzou.
71' Substitution. Santi Comesana will be replaced by Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
71' Substitution. Adria Altimira is replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
70' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
69' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
66' A snap shot by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Filip Jorgensen produces a good save to thwart him.
66' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla).
65' Surely that's handball by one of the Villarreal players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

65' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

64' What a chance! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
62' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) who loops his header high over the bar.
62' The corner kick from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
62' Half-chance! Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Filip Jorgensen reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
60' Although Marcelino (Villarreal) is just on the bench, Isidro Diaz de Mera has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

60' Adria Pedrosa finds Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he balloons the shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
59' Alex Baena (Villarreal) picks up a long through ball, but Marko Dmitrovic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
58' The ball rebounds to Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
58' The corner from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is hurriedly cleared.
58' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
54' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' The attendance is 33898.

50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
49' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
48' Good defending. Juan Foyth (Villarreal) tries to find Jose Luis Morales inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
47' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

46' Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a great save to deny Alex Baena (Villarreal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The game is over for Marcos Acuna (Sevilla). Adria Pedrosa comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+2' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.

45+2' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

45+2' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) produced a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Filip Jorgensen thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.

45+1' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:1.
43' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
41' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is able to continue to play.
39' Looks like Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle and it's Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' Alex Baena (Villarreal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
38' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Villarreal win a corner.
37' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

36' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Filip Jorgensen is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Sevilla get a corner.

35' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
34' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
32' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
31' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

31' This shall not pass! Djibril Sow (Sevilla) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) anticipates the cross from Dodi Lukebakio, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
27' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' A cross into the box from Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will take a throw-in.
24' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
20' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
17' A rebound spins to Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
17' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Sevilla take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
16' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
11' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Filip Jorgensen comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

8' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
5' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will referee today's match.
